$comment: Behavioral parity for inline markdown handling across the app/breve boundary (MIRROR-NOT-IMPORT: src/editor/stripMarkdown.ts stays independently implemented; breve-runtime/scripts/markdownText.ts is Breve's home). Per case: `text` = the marker-stripped reading, asserted by src/editor/stripMarkdown.test.ts; `html` = the rendered reading, asserted by breve-runtime/tests/test-markdown-text.ts (which also cross-checks that html minus tags equals text). The starred cases pin the canonical italic rule — emphasis opens/closes only against non-space content — that render-brief had drifted from (it used to italicize '2 * 3 * 4').
